callouts.title: 分子分母同增一个值发生的变化
callouts.body:
这主要取决于$\frac{b}{a}$与$1$的关系：

如果$0<\frac{b}{a}\leq 1$,并且$x>0$那么$$\frac{b+x}{a+x}\geq \frac{b}{a} $$否则不等式相反。此外，如果我们可以保证$0\leq x<\min\{a,b\}$,那么还有不等式$$\frac{b}{a}\geq \frac{b-x}{a-x}$$

classification_result.english_title: How a Fraction Changes When the Same Value Is Added to Numerator and Denominator

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Compare a ratio after adding or subtracting the same quantity
if_strategy_template.summary_en: This strategy tracks how a fraction $$\frac{b}{a}$$ changes when the same positive quantity is added to or subtracted from both numerator and denominator. The direction of the inequality depends on whether $$\frac{b}{a}$$ is at most or at least $1$.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Use this when an expression has the form $$\frac{b\pm x}{a\pm x}$$ and you want to compare it with $$\frac{b}{a}$$ in inequality estimates or monotonicity arguments.
